---
title: "chart-momentum"
format: html
params:
  db: "mdp_local"
---

```{r}
source("R/features.R")
con <- mdpr::mdp_connect(params$db)
x <- dplyr::collect(features(con))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

Only aggregate counts appear in the report.

```{r}
barplot(table(x$chart_position), xlab = "Chart position", ylab = "Observations")
```
